Codex at 540p: concurrency 4 gave a 10.4 s wall over 4 calls, 8 gave 17.6 s over 8, 12 gave 23.1 s over 12, and 16 gave 37.6 s with 4 HTTP 429 answers. The rate limit wall starts at 16, so 12 is the last level that answers without one. | 2026-11-06: 12 -> 4/4 (testbench/sched_1106/PLAN.md): the VDS gateway serves gpt-6-sol 4 at a time; at 12 the extra 8 queued upstream, 42-46 shot requests per film died in that queue after 60 s and the codex cooldown fired for 900-2400 s. 4 = the upstream lanes, so requests queue in the governor (priority: review first) instead.
